channel.title: provemark
channel.description: Measurements and notes on C2PA Content Credentials, from the maker of c2pa-verifier.

item.title: What WordPress image plugins do to Content Credentials
item.description: A signed image goes into WordPress; what does a visitor get? Measured for WordPress itself, seven image plugins and Jetpack's image CDN. The smaller sizes lose the credentials, some plugins replace the signed original, and twice a correct image came out looking tampered with.

item.title: How do you know a C2PA verifier is right?
item.description: A verifier that wrongly says Valid is worse than none. How c2pa-verifier, a C2PA verifier in pure PHP for hosts that can't run c2patool, is measured against the reference instead of trusted on its own tests — and the time the reference itself was wrong.

item.title: Two Article 50 deadlines, and which one is yours
item.description: Article 50(2) of the EU AI Act has applied since 2 August 2026, but the Digital Omnibus gave systems already on the market until 2 December 2026. Which date binds you depends on when your system was placed on the market — and the certificate, not the code, is the critical path.

item.title: From valid to trusted: the PHP route to production Content Credentials
item.description: PHP now has a Content Credentials library the Content Authenticity Initiative points at. Here is the rest of the map: how a deployment becomes a Conforming Product, what it costs, and what the security requirements ask of your architecture.

item.title: Three things that will cost you a day with C2PA
item.description: Article 50 of the EU AI Act applies since 2 August 2026. Three C2PA implementation traps found the hard way: sign() does not return your file, re-encoding silently destroys credentials, and trust verification can verify nothing without telling you.

item.title: Introducing stateful-check: generate programs, not values
item.description: A whole class of bugs lives not in a single input but in the order of operations. stateful-check generates command sequences, checks them against a shadow model, and shrinks a failure to a minimal counterexample. Model-based property testing for PHP.

item.title: Mocked ≠ real: the bug my unit tests were hiding
item.description: A green unit test hid a broken read path, because the mock was more forgiving than the real C2PA signing service. How a stateful property test caught it, and why mocks encode assumptions the code shares.

item.title: Introducing provemark: C2PA Content Credentials for PHP
item.description: A framework-agnostic PHP library to build, sign, read and verify C2PA Content Credentials — with first-class marking of AI-generated content under the EU AI Act, Article 50, and a Laravel integration.

item.title: Valid ≠ trusted: a practical guide to C2PA signing certificates
item.description: A hands-on guide to C2PA signing certificates from a working PHP implementation: test certs, the valid-vs-trusted distinction, trust lists, key isolation, and getting a production certificate.
